# Neukee

> Neukee helps engineering teams understand runtime, dependency, framework, and behavior risks before a software upgrade reaches production.

## Product

Neukee focuses on Node.js and Next.js upgrade readiness. Its intended local workflow inspects repository metadata and configuration, surfaces explainable findings, and can produce review-friendly CI evidence. Verify current capabilities against the source repository and release documentation before relying on them.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://neukee.github.io/): Product overview and interactive scan example.
- [Security](https://neukee.github.io/security/): Security boundaries and safe-use guidance.
- [Trust center](https://neukee.github.io/trust/): Project and operational trust information.
- [FAQ](https://neukee.github.io/faq/): Direct answers about product scope, privacy, and limitations.
- [Upgrade guides](https://neukee.github.io/guides/): Technical migration guides for Node.js and Next.js.
- [Field notes](https://neukee.github.io/blog/): Engineering notes and upgrade analysis.
- [Contact](https://neukee.github.io/contact/): Contact details and request paths.

## Technical guides

- [Node.js 22 to 26 breaking changes](https://neukee.github.io/guides/node-22-to-26-breaking-changes/): Runtime, native-addon, CI, and rollout considerations.
- [Next.js 15 to 16 upgrade guide](https://neukee.github.io/guides/nextjs-15-to-16-upgrade-guide/): Framework migration checks and behavioral changes.
- [Node.js 22 end-of-life migration checklist](https://neukee.github.io/guides/node-22-eol-migration-checklist/): An operational checklist for a controlled runtime change.
- [Verifying AI-agent pull requests in CI](https://neukee.github.io/guides/verify-ai-agent-prs-in-ci/): CI isolation and behavioral evidence for automated changes.

## Trust and contact

This site is statically hosted on GitHub Pages. Contact: [venuuu.nyc@proton.me](mailto:venuuu.nyc@proton.me). The site’s request forms prepare email drafts in the visitor’s own email client and do not submit information to a form backend.

Content describes intended project behavior and is not a guarantee that every release or deployment has the same properties. Consult the current source, release notes, and security page before making operational decisions.
